## Go and look — 8

Answered by looking at the system, the vehicle or a dialog. No decision, no test, nobody else involved. These are the ones to clear first, because several of the others are conditional on them.

### D-10 · Do we hold a POSPac MMS 8.6+ licence, and where is it installed?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **trajectory processing** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Determines whether trajectory processing and PFIX are available at all, and removes one of three degraded-GNSS remedies

*How to settle it.* Ask IT whether a POSPac MMS 8.6+ licence exists and where it is installed. D-19, T10 and V-9 all assume an answer.

> Holds up **D-19**, **T10**

### D-2 · Are GAMS and DMI fitted, and which mounting rack? (The configuration is answered: MX60 Premium.)

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **system** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* GAMS decides whether GAMS-assisted initialization is available; DMI decides whether DMI settings appear in trajectory processing and whether the published no-outage accuracy applies; the rack decides whether the published GAMS corner offsets apply

*How to settle it.* Walk out to the vehicle. Is a GAMS antenna pair fitted, is a DMI on a non-steering wheel, which rack. Settles five Preflight items and the whole GAMS/DMI branch of trajectory processing.

> Holds up **D-46** · Part answered: Configuration answered 2026-09-19: MX60 Premium, the top configuration - panoramas 12288x6144 px, roll/pitch 0.0025 deg, the better 60 s out

### T27 · What imagery streams actually exist on the MX60, and which are exposed through TBC export?

**P2** · **test** · **QC** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* The MX60 export tree shows no Planar cameras while the side-images option persists

*How to settle it.* The TMI device list, then the TBC export dialog. Answers V-8 at the same time.

### T7 · Registration Auto-Saving default state

**P2** · **test** · **registration** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Targets.csv is the registration field book and a wrong dialog answer empties it permanently

*How to settle it.* Open Register a Mission and read the Auto-Saving checkbox state. One look.

### V-2 · Is the MX60 laser control presented as Measurement Prog plus Line Speed, or a combined Laser Mode? Which TMI version applies?

**P2** · **vendor question** · **acquisition** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* The Quick Start Guide and TMI Rev L disagree - CONFLICT-005

*How to settle it.* Open TMI and read the screen. The Preflight asks the operator which presentation they saw; this says which one they will see.

### V-3 · Which TBC version is installed on our workstation?

**P2** · **vendor question** · **system** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Two version-dependent behaviours, both legacy - 5.21 and 5.80 predate the oldest published release note

*How to settle it.* Help > About in TBC. Two minutes, and every question about TBC behaviour below is conditional on the answer.

### V-8 · What is the MX60 actual camera complement, and which streams are exposed through TBC export?

**P2** · **vendor question** · **system** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Pairs with T27

*How to settle it.* The TMI device list names the cameras actually present. Same look as T27.

### T12 · DMI scale factor SD default 5 percent - was the wheel actually measured?

**P3** · **test** · **trajectory processing** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Trimble says set it to 100 percent if unknown

*How to settle it.* Ask whoever fitted the DMI whether the wheel was measured. If it was not, the 5 percent default stands and should be recorded as such.


## Parametrix decides — 34

No equipment, no vendor, no test. Somebody with the authority writes the answer down. This is the largest group and the cheapest, and it is what keeps every document in the set a living draft.

### D-15 · Is the control/check designation fixed before registration and unchangeable during it?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **registration** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Guards the failure that looks like diligence - a processor who dislikes a check residual and ticks the point into the adjustment

*How to settle it.* Fix the control/check designation before registration and forbid changing it during. The Office How To already says so; this makes it binding.

> Waits on **D-3**

### D-19 · IN-Fusion+ Single Base or PP-RTX?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **trajectory processing** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Determines whether a base station is occupied every mission, and the reference frame the solution is computed in

*How to settle it.* IN-Fusion+ Single Base or PP-RTX. Needs the licence question answered first.

> Waits on **D-10** · Holds up **D-42**

### D-21 · Which datum and epoch do we work in, who sets it, who checks it?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **project setup** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* A silent failure mode (the ITRF00 path) plus a user-settable epoch control Trimble flags as risky

*How to settle it.* Datum and epoch, who sets them, who checks them. Written once, applies to every project.

### D-3 · Roles and authorities - who may operate, register, accept a registration, run Cleanup, sign the accuracy statement, own calibration currency

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **all** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* The accepting person should not be the person who performed the adjustment

*How to settle it.* Who may operate, register, accept a registration, run Cleanup, sign an accuracy statement, own calibration currency. One table. D-15, D-29, D-35 and D-36 all wait on it.

> Holds up **D-15**, **D-35**, **D-29**

### D-35 · When may Cleanup be performed, by whom, and what must be archived first?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **cleanup** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Destructive, not undoable, reduces registration history at the moment the project is handed on

*How to settle it.* When Cleanup may be run and what must be archived first. The Archive and Cleanup checklist is already the sequence; this makes it binding.

> Waits on **D-3**

### D-36 · The export release gate - is the pre-export trajectory-node confirmation mandatory, and may exports be made with Export timestamps enabled before T18 resolves?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **export** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Registration does not reach the cloud until Update Scans runs; a documented export option may substitute reprocessed data

*How to settle it.* The export release gate, and whether exports may be made with Export timestamps enabled.

> Waits on **T18**

### D-39 · What is the corridor continuity inspection method and coverage?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **QC** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Must detect a degraded stretch shorter than the sampling interval, which rules out sparse spot checks

*How to settle it.* The corridor continuity inspection method and coverage. QC layer 6 is written; this fixes what it covers.

### D-42 · Base station strategy and maximum baseline?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **mission planning** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Field logistics on every mission. Interacts with D-19

*How to settle it.* Base station strategy and maximum baseline. Means nothing until the trajectory method is chosen.

> Waits on **D-19**

### D-46 · Where are lever arms, the Vehicle Preset and the installation configuration recorded and verified?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **field preparation** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Entered once, used every mission. An error is systematic, invisible, and persists until someone re-measures

*How to settle it.* Where lever arms, the Vehicle Preset and the installation configuration are recorded and verified.

> Waits on **D-2**

### D-49 · Field close-out - what the mission field record contains, what coverage verification happens before leaving site, what triggers a re-drive and who decides

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **field QC** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* No software produces the field record. Missed overlap removes office options irrecoverably

*How to settle it.* Largely written already: Appendix B and the Field Record Form are the content. This adopts them.

### D-52 · Transfer, verification and backup procedure

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **transfer** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* The only irreversible step in the workflow

*How to settle it.* Transfer, verification and backup. The Field How To already describes it; this makes it the procedure.

### D-26 · Recalibration interval and triggers - does daily removal of the Sensor Unit count as disturbing it? What happens to data collected on a stale calibration?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **calibration** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* If the head comes off nightly, calibration is routine rather than periodic

*How to settle it.* Recalibration interval and triggers, and what happens to data collected on a stale calibration. Waits on Trimble saying whether refitting the Sensor Unit disturbs it.

> Waits on **V-13**

### D-29 · The record package - what provenance record accompanies a deliverable, where does it live, and where is the control/check designation and its residuals recorded?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **provenance** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Six facts cannot be reconstructed from the deliverable; TBC is not documented as reporting the designation

*How to settle it.* The record package: what accompanies a deliverable and where it lives.

> Waits on **D-3**

### D-32 · What is our position on imagery privacy? Are unblurred originals retained, and for how long?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **export** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Legal and reputational dimensions outside the SOP. Blurring is irreversible in the delivered product

*How to settle it.* Imagery privacy, and whether unblurred originals are retained. A policy and legal question, not a technical one; it needs whoever owns records retention.

> Holds up **D-55**

### D-41 · How many passes, in what pattern, by roadway type?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **mission planning** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Two of three degraded-GNSS remedies require overlap collected on the day

*How to settle it.* Passes and pattern by roadway type. Informed by the overlap test.

> Waits on **T24**

### D-55 · Capture and retention - what is retained, where, for how long, by whom, including Backup SBET Next to MXDB, Results of Scan Generation, and the calibration JSON

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **archive** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Tier 1 is a few hundred kilobytes. Tier 3 is hundreds of GB and determines whether reprocessing is ever possible

*How to settle it.* Retention: what is kept, where, for how long, by whom. Overlaps the imagery privacy question.

> Waits on **D-32**

### D-13 · What constitutes an acceptable registration and an acceptable point cloud?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **QC** · **day**

*Why it matters.* No Trimble source provides a threshold. Must combine residuals, independent checks, visual inspection and the project accuracy requirement

*How to settle it.* The acceptance criteria. Nothing may be quoted to a client until this exists, and it should not be written before the registration and control tests give it numbers.

> Waits on **T15**

### D-16 · Control design - how many control points, at what spacing, how many independent checks, and does density vary with predicted GNSS conditions?

**P1** · **Parametrix decision** · **project setup** · **day**

*Why it matters.* No Trimble source states any. TBC minimum of one pair is a mathematical floor. Local does not extrapolate

*How to settle it.* Control design: how many points, at what spacing, how many independent checks. With D-13, the pair that blocks delivering for a stated accuracy purpose.

> Waits on **T25**

### D-28 · Is the retro-reflective target check our periodic verification, and at what interval?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **calibration** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* The only independent check on the instrument in any source

*How to settle it.* Whether the retro-reflective target check is our periodic verification, and at what interval.

> Waits on **V-14**

### D-1 · Who owns this SOP, who approves revisions, on what review cycle?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **document control** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* TBC is on an annual release cycle and each release has changed mobile mapping behaviour

*How to settle it.* Name the owner and the review cycle, one line, into SOP Appendix C. Costs nothing, and nothing in this set can be adopted until somebody owns it.

### D-11 · Is LiDAR QC a capability we intend to have?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **trajectory processing** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* 128-256 GB RAM, dedicated SSDs, MATLAB Runtime. Urgent only when it is too late

*How to settle it.* Whether LiDAR QC is a capability we intend to have. T13 and V-9 only matter if it is.

> Holds up **T13**

### D-12 · Registration command selection - is Register a Mission the corridor default, and where does run-to-run sit?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **registration** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* The three commands are not interchangeable. Run-to-run uses no control and propagates the reference run absolute error

*How to settle it.* The corridor default registration command. Decide once the registration-type test has been run.

> Waits on **T15**

### D-53 · Folder structure, naming and storage location

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **transfer** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Several provenance artefacts are small files loose in a project folder

*How to settle it.* Folder structure and naming. The Field Tools record ids already assume a project and a task; this is where those records land.

### D-56 · Does Parametrix adopt Trimble's documented initialization sequence, closing sequence and control-bracketing design rule as mandatory Parametrix requirements?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **Field** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Trimble documents these methods but does not state them as requirements - it writes 'should', 'it is advised', and 'Proposal of a checklist for system operation'. They carry TRIMBLE DOCUMENTED METHOD and 'should' until Parametrix decides. Nothing else makes them mandatory.

*How to settle it.* Adopt Trimble's documented initialization, closing and control-bracketing sequences as Parametrix requirements, or keep them as recommended practice. One meeting, and it turns 'should' into 'shall' across the Field How To.

### D-24 · Where is the calibration site, and who maintains it?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **calibration** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Establishing one is a morning of work; finding one under schedule pressure is not

*How to settle it.* Where the calibration site is and who maintains it. D-26 is hollow without it.

### D-27 · QC inspection content - what does a visual point-cloud QC pass cover, and an imagery QC pass?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **QC** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Two QC layers produce no software artefact at all

*How to settle it.* What a visual point-cloud QC pass and an imagery QC pass cover.

> Waits on **T16**

### D-34 · Handling segments mobile mapping cannot serve - the decision rule when a corridor produces an unacceptable trajectory, and whether marginal segments are recorded before mobilising

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **mission planning** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Includes the legitimate professional answer that another method would be more defensible

*How to settle it.* The decision rule when a corridor produces an unacceptable trajectory, and whether marginal segments are delivered.

### D-38 · Deliverable specification - standard formats, which export path produces each, and default scaling

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **export** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* Ground scaling does not record its own scale factor; grid writes a sidecar that does

*How to settle it.* Standard deliverable formats, which export path produces each, and default scaling.

### D-43 · Field operating rules - wet-weather go/no-go with operator stand-down authority, night collection, collection speed by deliverable type, free-space margin

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **acquisition** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* An operator who must phone for permission will drive. Trimble publishes speed maxima and no relation to deliverable quality

*How to settle it.* Field operating rules: wet-weather go/no-go with operator stand-down authority, night collection, speed by deliverable type, free-space margin.

### D-57 · Is airfield pavement roughness - Boeing Bump Index and IRI - a service Parametrix intends to offer, and if so what control and validation scheme proves the vertical?

**P2** · **Parametrix decision** · **project setup** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* It is a real TBC capability and a strong differentiator, but an FAA-facing deliverable rests on the vertical trajectory rather than on instrument precision. The control scheme has to be agreed before collection, not after, and whether a given reviewing authority accepts a mobile-mapping-derived profile is a question to ask them

*How to settle it.* Whether airfield pavement roughness is a service Parametrix offers, and on what validation scheme.

> Waits on **T32**

### D-22 · Are scans generated coloured by default?

**P3** · **Parametrix decision** · **scan generation** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Discovering later that colour was wanted means regenerating the mission

*How to settle it.* Whether scans are generated coloured by default.

### D-31 · Is the imagery file-size scan adopted?

**P3** · **Parametrix decision** · **QC** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* Validation required first - file size alone cannot establish image validity

*How to settle it.* Whether the imagery file-size scan is adopted as a QC step.

### D-54 · Is a chain-of-custody record required?

**P3** · **Parametrix decision** · **transfer** · **minutes**

*Why it matters.* The deliverable may not be able to speak for itself

*How to settle it.* Whether a chain-of-custody record is required. The Field Tools record already carries most of one.

### D-18 · What is verified at import, and by whom?

**P3** · **Parametrix decision** · **intake** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Seven checks, each cheaper now than later

*How to settle it.* What is verified at import and by whom. The Office Processing checklist already lists the checks.

## At the workstation — 21

TBC and a dataset we already have. No collection needed. Most are an hour; the three marked a day are the ones that produce numbers other decisions need.

### T28 · Does Cleanup delete sbet_*_reg_####.out from storage, or only remove the project objects?

**P1** · **test** · **cleanup** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* Determines what must be archived before Cleanup. Distinguish project object retention from underlying file retention

*How to settle it.* On a scratch copy of a project, never a live one, because the command cannot be undone.

### T3 · Does Reflective Panels remove legitimate retro-reflective returns from signs and line marking?

**P1** · **test** · **scan generation** · **hour**

*Why it matters.* On sign and retroreflectivity work those returns are the deliverable

*How to settle it.* Needs one generated run with signs and line marking in it.

### T18 · Export the same registered run twice, timestamps off and on, and compare point geometry. Does reprocessing from raw reflect the registered trajectory?

**P1** · **test** · **export** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* The highest-priority test. A documented export option may deliver data that was never the data that was checked

*How to settle it.* Export the same registered run twice, timestamps off and on, and compare geometry. Blocks the export release gate.

> Holds up **D-36**

### T29 · Establish the reliable export-state verification method for each export path

**P1** · **test** · **export** · **half-day**

*Why it matters.* How an export dialog resolves its selection is not documented

*How to settle it.* Establish the reliable export-state verification method for each export path.

### T15 · Which registration type, when? Test Global, Local and Global-then-Local with independent checks

**P1** · **test** · **registration** · **day**

*Why it matters.* No selection rule published. Global-then-Local gets no guidance and appears in every Trimble screenshot

*How to settle it.* Global, Local and Global-then-Local with independent checks. The test D-12 and D-13 both wait on, and the single most valuable day at the workstation.

> Holds up **D-12**, **D-13**

### T32 · Run the TBC Boeing Bump Index report end to end on an MX60 dataset: what inputs does the command take, what does it output, and does the vertical quality of an ordinary run support an FAA profile?

**P1** · **test** · **QC** · **day**

*Why it matters.* TBC ships the analysis under Mobile Mapping - Analysis - Boeing Bump Index and it is a sellable deliverable. Nobody here has run it. The open question is not whether the tool exists but whether our vertical trajectory supports the profile it computes from, which is answered by validating against pavement control, not by the nominal accuracy

*How to settle it.* The TBC Boeing Bump Index report end to end on an MX60 dataset. Blocks D-57 and the airfield offer.

> Holds up **D-57**
